name: Fictional F40 glass diagnostic starter
purpose: Provide deterministic implementation defaults for a minimal asymmetric F40 glass and normal diagnostic corridor; this remains fictional executable documentation rather than retained F40 evidence.
ownership: constant neutral World owns broad far-field fill
one overhead Area light owns general direct illumination
two emissive finite panels own asymmetric bright reflection bands
one dark diffuse panel owns a reflection absorber region
a dry neutral road owns visible ground and lower-hemisphere contact
no atmosphere or weather contribution exists in this profile

background_color.notes: Deterministic neutral starter value; not a measured sky or calibrated grey environment.

background_strength.notes: Chosen for diagnostic readability and intended to remain fixed across comparison variants.

energy.notes: Diagnostic starter value, not photometric calibration.

size.notes: Broad source intended to avoid small highlight clutter.

dimensions.notes: Finite geometry for broad asymmetric reflection movement.
Different size and placement prevent bilateral reflection symmetry.
Large enough for the initial static and orbit diagnostic.

base_color.notes: Neutral dark ground; not a measured asphalt reflectance.

roughness.notes: No procedural road texture is present in the Level 0 diagnostic.

cloud_state.notes: Cloud reflections would add an unnecessary moving frequency field.

precipitation.notes: Rain and windshield water are forbidden until the glass fault is classified.

wind.unit: metres per second in world axes
wind.notes: No animated environmental system exists in this profile.

weather.recent_history: Dry diagnostic state with no physical weather-history claim.

exposure.notes: Must remain fixed during comparison; adjust only in a separately recorded calibration pass.

white_balance.notes: The executed scene must still record its exact colour-management state.

camera.display_transform: record the exact active Blender 5.0.1 view transform and look at execution; do not change it between variants

lens.unit: millimetres on a 36 mm sensor-width implementation default
lens.notes: One diagnostic camera only; additional orbit views must retain explicit transforms.

diagnostics: broad left and right reflection bands can be hidden independently
dark absorber can be hidden independently
chrome grey black-gloss and glass proxy spheres are present
no atmosphere weather HDRI or compositor effect is active
windshield material sequence proceeds from opaque grey to specular to minimal glass
camera and environment movement are tested independently
Cycles is the first classification engine before an EEVEE comparison
limitations: No value is a radiometric or photometric measurement.
The profile has not been executed against the private F40 export by the repository change that introduced it.
The script does not inspect or modify the F40 windshield.
Emission and Area-light values may require exposure-preserving adjustment after the first retained Blender render.
The profile is intended for fault isolation rather than final paint or exterior presentation.
